title: A house cost $23,000 in 1970. Now? #shorts
description:
In 1970, the typical new American home sold for about $23,000. Today it's about $393,000, almost twice as expensive even after inflation.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: Median sales price of new houses (Census/HUD), median household income (Census), housing starts (Census), 30-year mortgage rate (Freddie Mac), CPI (BLS), retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script, characters and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
